name: Artists' Exchange Summer Camps
description_short: Weekly arts day camps (9am-3pm) in Cranston, RI, run by a non-profit community arts center. Options include art, little art, ceramics/clay, digital media/stop-motion animation, and theater & dance camps for ages 6-14.
refund_policy_summary: Camps canceled by Artists' Exchange are fully refunded; single days lost to weather or COVID quarantine are credited. Families who cancel at least two weeks before camp get a refund minus a $50 non-refundable fee. The fee is waived if they transfer to another camp or keep the money as a credit. Cancellations made less than two weeks before camp are not refunded.
